correctness.rationale: Every derivation is f d/dx, D_f^2=ff′d/dx, f=a(x²)+xb(x²), so the 2-nullcone conditions are ab=b²=0 in F_q[t]/t^M. t-valuations give all allowable b and a, and the linear rank is M-min(v(a),v(b)), yielding a disjoint exhaustive enumerator. Conditioning on v(b) gives a uniform grid and a geometrically bounded rank deficit, proving the distributional limit and O_q(1/M) Wasserstein distance. Direct matrix squares and ranks matched all eleven exhaustive small-field tests; independent auditing was not performed.

value.rationale: The rank stratification of the restricted 2-nullcone is a natural invariant of the derivation Lie algebra of each truncated local algebra. Its exact two-parameter polynomial is a complete spectrum across an infinite family; the uniform limiting rank instead of point concentration identifies non-obvious large-dimensional structure. Counts do not follow from the known p-map closure or from ambient derivation-space dimension.
